nom: RODAN + FIELDS Redefine Multi-Function Eye Cream for Undereye Wrinkles + Crow's Feet

avis.texte: It does the job. Keeps my 59 year old eye area hydrated without being heavy and really helps with fine lines.

Unfortunately i noticed no difference using this cream. I bought it for fine lines under my eyes. I waited to leave a review until the small tub was completely empty. I only used once a day at night though. I will say i liked the creamy thickness of the cream and it did seem like it moisturized my skin well.

I've been using this consistently for over 3 months and I am really happy with the results. My skin is smoother and visibly less fine lines than before. The cream blends nicely with your skin and it doesn't leave a greasy or tacky feeling like some others.
So far working I just can't put too much until I use it for 30 days
Not all eye creams are created equal! So, there is a smoothness and radiance to this cream that brings my sparkle back. Pricey, well a little, but it is worth it.

avis.titre: Sadly hasn't worked for me yet
avis.texte: Just hasn't worked. I've besn using it twice daily since I got it but no results.
It's like I can see a difference immediately. I really love this multi function eye cream. Under my eyes doesn't puff out as it once did. I use it everyday!!!

I have used this product for some years now and love it!! My concern with your latest ad showing use for lids and under eyes is that new customers don't realize product is in a tiny bottle which customers will go through quickly. That becomes Very expensive in my opinion. I will continue to use this product as it has worked, but I know I can't afford to use more than I do.

Be sure to take a before & after photo in the same light. In even a few weeks you will see a remarkable difference. I've purchased this eye cream as gifts and each one has agreed with great results and continued buying it for themselves. (Remember to do before & after to really appreciate the difference)
Love this cream! Have noticed improvements in the first 2 weeks!
I love the feel of this cream, the fresh scent and the way it works!! I will never be without it!

Nice cream. Doesn't really work with my hooded eyes. It doesn't really moisturize under eye like my other Medi grade skincare. No smell so that is nice. Still on the hunt for a cream that actually works.

Have been using this product from last 8 years. This is my one of MUST HAVES!! No signs of crow feet, very effective. Highly recommend this multi -function Eye Cream. The texture is so smooth makes your eyes very smooth and well hydrated.
Use for wrinkles in eye area. I wish it helped more with puffiness under the eye.
This product is amazing! I have 2 small tags on my right eyelid and this product is making them shrink! I love this and I will be buying more when it's gone!!
I had to stop using the product because it makes my eyes teary. Unfortunately, I can't say whether the product is effective or not. For me, it's been a waste of money.

I was skeptical on making such a pricey purchase on what seems to be a small pot of product. Rhodan and Fields came through again with a product thst does what it says. Over 50 and the skin on my eyelids are crepey and are accentuated when adding any eyeshadow with the least bit if shimmer. Within days of using the product the texture of my eyelids became noticeably smoother. One of yhe guys in my office is still trying to figure out what is different. A small detail that makes a big statement. I would have given 5 stars but the price point keeps me from that but it isnt going to stop me from purchasing the larger jar in the future.
does not do the job I had thought. compared to the other products it is not so good.

This is the only eye cream I can use that doesn't irritate the skin around my eyes. I can't speak to the benefits yet, but hoping i see results :) I am allergic to phenoxyethanol and thankfully this eye cream does not contain this ingredient.
The eye cream is wonderful and makes my undereye area feel moisturized.
Seems to irritate my eyes. Under eye bags look worse. Will not purchase again.
I had previously used R&F Eye Cream but had ran out, bought some at the mall to fill in, and noticed a considerable difference! I am thrilled to be back on the top shelf eye cream! Thank you R&F!
I didn't see the results that everyone else is seeing. This cream is very expensive and did not work on my eyes
I purchased this to help with tightening my eyelids. It's a nice eye cream but I did not see any improvement.
This was sold under the premise that it would tighten the hooded eyes. I have not found anything reduced. It's merely a moisturizer.

I purchased this product because over time, my eyelids have become heavier than I'd like them to be. Although the cream feels wonderful on my skin and is a great moisturizer, I haven't seen that much improvement on my eyelids. I am applying it in the morning and at night, perhaps I'm doing something wrong?
This eye cream is amazing! It makes the lines under my eyes so much less noticeable. I highly recommend this product!
I love this product. I have very sensitive skin, especially around my eyes and this product does not irritate it at all. It makes my skin feel smooth and soft.

A purchase this ice cream a couple years. Ago, I've never found somebody better than that. I even tried LA mer a few times which is also good cream. But this is really closer to it. It lived the eyes in Brighton and just make you look much younger. I just love it very much. I recommend it very highly thank you so much
Use it every day! No hoods on me! No irritation either. This product is one of my favorites!!
I have hooded eyes and was even told I should get surgery. I use this day and night and I already see a little difference. It's only been about a week and a half.
I've been using this eye cream for a few weeks now and I feel like I am noticing a little bit of a difference in that my eyelids aren't as droopy

avis.titre: Not what it used to be
avis.texte: I remember about 20 years ago that the eye would lift, take wrinkles away and end the puffiness. Yes, I see a bit of a difference but the puffiness isn't going away.

I've been using this for a couple of weeks and have definitely noticed a difference. At 59, I definitely have droopier upper lids that make me look tired all the time. This cream has noticeably improved that.

I've been using this cream for a while but this is the first time I purchase it direct from the manufacturer. The quality of the product was much higher than when purchased through retailers that sell your product. It was filled to the top, it was fresh and fluffy and it applies great.
I have been using this since 2013 -Im 63 and my crows feet are minimal!
I had high hopes for this product and it's not lived up to my expectations
One of my favorite products. Soothing and smoothing to my under eyes.
Not really seeing any results. I'll use the whole jar just because of the price I paid, but I'm not impressed with the results as of now.
Not completely sure yet. Wanted something for entire eye area. So far it is good. Need to use a bit longer. A little dab is all you need.
Don't like the 2 month renewal for this product tho! You have to be diligent to cancel the shipment BEFORE they ship it or you have to jump thru hoops to return it!
This is the smoothest and most perfecting eye cream I have ever tried. I'm 75 and it really helps with my lines around my eyes
I recently started using this eye cream. I love the consistency and the texture of the cream. In addition my eye wrinkles are slowly becoming less noticeable.
I have tried other skincare but always come back to R & F. I love the eye cream and entire redefine line.

I have only been using this for about two weeks. I do think it helps with the baggy eyes and dark circles, but their is not a lot of product in the jar. . . I feel like I already need to order another one.
Feels light and refreshing around the eyes. Only used it a couple of weeks so difficult to notice a difference, but maybe added a little firmness with the eyelids
I never miss this part of my regimen. This keeps my wrinkles around my eyes to a minimum.
I love this eye cream! Within 5 days I noticed smoother lids and skin around my eyes.
I like the feel of the product but have noticed no changes in my appearance.
Was expecting great things from this eye cream but it didn't deliver.
Love how this helps with my wrinkles around my eyes any eye lids!
This goes on great and absorbs quickly. It's too soon to see if there's an improvement in lines but I do expect so!
I've been using for a month now and don't really see much improvement with this product or the line I purchased that goes with it. Over 200. 00 for not much, disappointing.
Haven't seen much difference yet. Been using it for about 3 weeks but I am glad my skin isn't burning off as some creams tend to do.
This eye cream is a game changer, I couldn't be without this product!
Really have seen effects in just the few weeks since I started using it.

avis.titre: Love having less under eye bags
avis.texte: The Multi function Eye Cream is the best thing for under eye bags. I use it day and night and have seen significant results.

My cousin suggested I try this eye cream. I really didn't think it would do anything. But suddenly today , I noticed the area above the eye lid crease looked more lifted and that one little annoying wrinkle was less. I will buy again.
I haven't seen any sign that it is working at all. Will keep trying

Fabulous! Before, if I tried to swipe eye shadow on my lid it just stuck together like saran wrap. After only 1 week it held firm and my brush glided across my lid. My skin around my eyes is firmer, brighter and makes me look more awake.
This hasn't reduced lines/wrinkles. I'll keep using it to see if it actually works.
I have sensitive skin, and this product doesn't bother me, and feels refreshing.

I'm 45 and this has been my Go To eye cream for the last 10 years. I started using this eye cream for my crows feet and it works. I just recently had a colleague ask me how I don't have crows feet and I was like Rodan And fields!!! To anyone contemplating this eye cream... Just Don't You won't be disappointed !!!

i have been using this religiously for years, but i have no idea if it is actually doing anything. i like the product container and the consistency of the product. it is easy to apply. i just don't notice a difference if it is doing anything for wrinkles to my eye area.
I have been consistent using this how ever I don't see any change in my upper lid. Really not any better than any other eye cream I have used

I recently purchased this eye cream for my droopy eyelids. I thought why not give it a try ~ I am glad I did! I haven't been using a full 30 days yet but I already notice an improvement. It isn't drastic where someone might say what did you have done but I see it and that's what makes me think this is a solid product it's going to continue to improve with continued use. No need for anything else. I also love that the cream is silky, non irritating and doesn't have a heavy scent.
I have been using for over 10 years and I love it ! If you take a before and after picture you will see the difference! No puffiness or dark circles and my wrinkles look firm and smooth!!
I absolutely love the Redefine eye cream. I have been using it for years and at the age of 52, I love how little wrinkles I have around my eyes. Kind of swear by this stuff.
This cream is wonderful for sensitive eyes. It doesn't irritate or itch and absorbs well. I feel like it hydrates better than any other eye cream I've used before. Definitely worth the money.
It was recommended by my consultant, and she was right, my eyes look brighter and there is less puffiness
This special eye cream doesn't seem to make any more difference than the day crean. . . and the quantity is so small.
The texture is not the issue. But some reason every time I applied, I had redness under my eyes.

avis.titre: Not happy with my last 2 shipments
avis.texte: Not these as it was for the past 5 years. Smaller and more expensive. Less results. Looking for a new skin care line.
